answer.reason: The verses give several defining events of the Spirit's coming, among many teaching and doctrinal statements that are not deeds.

clauses.english: came upon Mary, who was found with child of the Holy Ghost
clauses.quote: she was found with child of the Holy Ghost

clauses.english: descended like a dove upon Jesus at his baptism
clauses.quote: he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove, and lighting upon him

clauses.english: filled the disciples at Pentecost, and they spoke with other tongues
clauses.quote: they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues

doubts: Many marked verses are teaching or doctrine (ROM 8, 1CO 2, EPH 4:30, 1JN 5:7), not events, so they were left out.
The Gentile Pentecost at Cornelius's house (ACT 10:44) and the sending of Barnabas and Saul (ACT 13:2-4) were also left out to keep the line short.
